stories.title: 多個加密項目網站遭 DNS 劫持釣魚
stories.title_en: DNS Hijacking Hits Multiple Crypto Project Websites
stories.summary: Flap、Kintsu 等站被導向 Step Drainer 惡意頁；Blockaid 點名約 12 個站，呼籲唔好連錢包／簽名。
stories.summary_en: Flap.sh and others redirected to Step Drainer pages; Blockaid flagged ~12 sites; revoke approvals if needed.
stories.why_it_matters: 釣魚／DNS 劫持會即時偷錢包；模擬倉以外亦提醒核對官方頻道先連錢包。

stories.title: Ethereum 驗證者大舉接入 mump2p 加速出塊
stories.title_en: Ethereum Validators Boost Network Speed with mump2p Adoption Surge
stories.summary: Optimum mump2p 主網後一週 TVB +76% 至約 249 萬 ETH；平均早 277ms 見到區塊。
stories.summary_en: Optimum mump2p: Total Value Boosted +76% to ~2.49M ETH; blocks ~277ms earlier on average.
stories.why_it_matters: 出塊／傳播加快會影響套利同急升捕捉窗口；廣度同延遲環境值得留意。

stories.title: Trezor 警告 Safe 5 遭植入竊聽板
stories.title_en: Trezor Warns of Hardware Implant in Safe 5 from Former Reseller
stories.summary: 印尼用戶開箱發現額外電路板可讀助記詞並以流動訊號傳出；Trezor 切斷該經銷商並呼籲轉移資金。
stories.summary_en: Implant between board and screen can exfiltrate seed via cellular; Trezor cut reseller, urges fund moves.
stories.why_it_matters: 硬體供應鏈攻擊直接威脅冷錢包；買官方渠道同開箱檢查仍然關鍵。

stories.title: Ansem 開約 88 萬美元 10x SOL 空單
stories.title_en: Ansem Opens $880K 10x Short on SOL Amid $ANSEM Token Crash
stories.summary: 用 Pump.fun 新永續功能做 10x SOL short；同期 $ANSEM 由高峰大跌約九成。
stories.summary_en: ~$880k 10x SOL short via Pump.fun perps; $ANSEM down ~90% from peak.
stories.why_it_matters: KOL 槓桿空單同 meme 崩跌會放大 Solana 波動；急升表宜睇廣度而非單一喊單。

stories.title: OnePay 支援 USDC 直入支票戶口
stories.title_en: OnePay Enables Direct USDC Deposits to Checking Accounts
stories.summary: Walmart 背景 OnePay 經 Stripe Bridge 將 USDC 即時轉美元入帳；支援多鏈。
stories.summary_en: Walmart-backed OnePay converts USDC to dollars in checking via Stripe Bridge across 12 chains.
stories.why_it_matters: 穩定幣入日常銀行通道＝法幣流動性敘事；風險偏好同穩定幣溢價會受影響。

stories.title: SPX6900 靠社區信念撐住約 3.4 億市值
stories.title_en: SPX6900 Memecoin Thrives on Relentless Community Positivity
stories.summary: 無團隊路線圖、靠 DCA 同 meme；現價約 $0.36，見大額現貨買入。
stories.summary_en: No team/roadmap; community DCA/memes; ~$0.36 with large spot buys.
stories.why_it_matters: 弱市仍有社區 meme 吸金；對照急升捕捉要分清敘事熱同可交易流動性。

stories.title: 幣安被盜後 Satoshi 錢包仍紋絲不動
stories.title_en: Satoshi's $85 Billion Bitcoin Sits Untouched Amid Binance Hack Fears
stories.summary: 約 109.6 萬 BTC（~$85B）分散逾 2 萬地址 15 年未動；對比 CEX 熱錢包風險。
stories.summary_en: ~1.096M BTC (~$85B) across 21k+ addresses unmoved 15+ years vs CEX hot-wallet risk.
stories.why_it_matters: 對比自我保管同交易所託管風險；市場情緒仍受 CEX 事故主導。

stories.title: Strategy 改以優先股籌資繼續囤 BTC
stories.title_en: Strategy Details Preferred Stock Shift for Bitcoin Buys Amid Earnings Volatility
stories.summary: Q3：持有 848,517 BTC；改以 STRC 等優先股買幣，普通股主要應付股息利息。
stories.summary_en: 848,517 BTC held; preferred (STRC) for BTC buys; common equity reserved for dividends/interest.
stories.why_it_matters: 企業囤幣融資結構影響 BTC 買盤節奏同 MSTR／風險資產聯動。

stories.title: 香港穩定幣 HKDAP 登陸 Solana
stories.title_en: Anchorpoint Brings HKD Stablecoin HKDAP to Solana Blockchain
stories.summary: Anchorpoint（渣打香港／HKT／Animoca）獲牌後將 HKDAP 由 ETH beta 擴至 Solana。
stories.summary_en: HKMA-licensed Anchorpoint expands HKDAP from Ethereum beta onto Solana with Foundation partnership.
stories.why_it_matters: 非美元穩定幣上 Solana 強化亞洲支付同 RWA 敘事；可睇 SOL 生態資金流。

stories.title: Druckenmiller 力撐 ICE×Hyperliquid 美期貨合作
stories.title_en: Stan Druckenmiller Backs trade[XYZ] in ICE-Hyperliquid U.S. Futures Deal
stories.summary: ICE 與 trade[XYZ]/Hyperliquid 擬推 24/7 美股／商品／加密永續（待 CFTC）；HYPE 曾急升逾一成。
stories.summary_en: ICE + trade[XYZ]/Hyperliquid plan 24/7 US perps pending CFTC; HYPE jumped >10%.
stories.why_it_matters: 傳統交易所入場永續會帶動 HYPE／監管敘事；急升表宜跟監管催化。

stories.title: Polymarket 因第三方腳本被入侵停市約一小時
stories.title_en: Polymarket Halts Trading After Third-Party Hack Drains $2.7 Million
stories.summary: DebugBear 監控腳本被植入；約 $270 萬被抽走，平台退款並另補交易損失。
stories.summary_en: Compromised DebugBear RUM script drained ~$2.7M; refunds + trading-loss top-ups.
stories.why_it_matters: 前端第三方腳本風險會打擊預測市場同風險偏好；安全敘事持續主導周末盤。

stories.title: 交易員 Frank 平倉逾千萬美元 meme 空單
stories.title_en: Crypto Trader Frank Closes Million-Dollar Memecoin Shorts
stories.summary: 平掉 BTC／ZEC／NEAR／PUMP 等約 $1230 萬槓桿空單；meme 總市值由高峰大回落。
stories.summary_en: Closed ~$12.3M leveraged shorts (BTC/ZEC/NEAR/PUMP); memecoin mcap down from peaks.
stories.why_it_matters: 大戶平空＝波動來源轉方向；追急升要分清空頭回補同真需求。

stories.title: 幣安確認約 63 億美元被盜並承諾全數賠償
stories.title_en: Binance Hit by Record $6.3 Billion Hack from North Korean Group
stories.summary: 疑因 DevOps 筆電被入侵，跨鏈熱錢包被抽走約 63 億；已凍結約 30 億，餘額由 SAFU／庫房覆蓋，存取逐步恢復。
stories.summary_en: Lazarus/TraderTraitor compromised a DevOps laptop; ~$6.3B hot-wallet drain; ~$3B frozen; SAFU/reserves to cover; deposits/withdrawals resuming.
stories.why_it_matters: 史上級 CEX 事故會拖累風險偏好同穩定幣流動性；模擬倉宜留意廣度同波動。

stories.title: 比特幣白皮書發表十八周年
stories.title_en: Eighteen Years Since Satoshi's Bitcoin Whitepaper Debut
stories.summary: 2008-10-31 Satoshi 發出九頁白皮書；社群紀念不變規則同 2100 萬上限。
stories.summary_en: Satoshi emailed the nine-page paper on 2008-10-31; communities mark Whitepaper Day and the 21M cap.
stories.why_it_matters: 紀念日情緒或短暫帶動 BTC 敘事，但唔改短期技術面。

stories.title: Chainalysis 確認遭入侵洩客戶聯絡資料
stories.title_en: Chainalysis Confirms Cybersecurity Breach Exposing Customer Contact Details
stories.summary: 外部攻擊者以進階手法取得姓名、電郵、用戶 ID 同角色標籤；公司稱調查內容同密碼未受影響，並強調與幣安盜案無關。
stories.summary_en: Non-sensitive contact data exposed via offensive agentic techniques; no investigation content or passwords; unrelated to Binance heist.
stories.why_it_matters: 合規／調查商也被打中，業界釣魚風險升；留意冒充電郵。

stories.title: 網紅警告 Hyperliquid 或臨近被攻擊風險
stories.title_en: Crypto Influencer Warns of Imminent Hyperliquid Exploit
stories.summary: Dogecoin 大戶 Yazan 於幣安被盜後公開警告，叫人唔好把負擔唔起嘅資金留喺 Hyperliquid；社群反應兩極，暫未見實際 exploit。
stories.summary_en: After Binance hack, influencer Yazan warned against leaving unaffordable funds on Hyperliquid; mixed reactions; no exploit confirmed yet.
stories.why_it_matters: CEX 事故後資金遷徙／恐慌會影響 HYPE 同永續成交；留意 FUD 同真實漏洞差異。

stories.title: Cursor 市集假 Claude 擴充藏 SSH 後門
stories.title_en: Malicious Claude Code Extension Hits Cursor Marketplace with SSH Backdoor
stories.summary: 假 Anthropic Claude Code 擴充上架約 11 小時，可推 SSH key／反向隧道；Cursor 已下架並促更新清理。
stories.summary_en: Fake Claude Code 2.1.313 on Cursor marketplace ~11h; SSH key/reverse tunnel; update to 2.1.314 and clean remnants.
stories.why_it_matters: 開發工具鏈被攻會間接影響金鑰同部署安全。

stories.title: MSTR 跌約 9% 交易員大舉買認沽
stories.title_en: Traders Bet Big on MicroStrategy Puts as Stock Drops 9%
stories.summary: 股價受加密市況同交易所事故拖累；期權市場偏空活躍。
stories.summary_en: MSTR ~-9% near $129; heavy put activity after hack-driven crypto weakness.
stories.why_it_matters: BTC 代理股避險情緒，可反映整體風險偏好。

stories.title: Monad 公開對抗 AI 攻擊嘅 OpSec 工具包
stories.title_en: Monad Shares Security Tools and Guides Against AI-Powered Crypto Threats
stories.summary: 發布 Crypto OpSec Bible 同開源 Ultrafuzz；數據指社工／控制權劫持損失遠超合約漏洞。
stories.summary_en: Monad released OpSec Bible + open-source Ultrafuzz; social-engineering losses dwarf contract bugs.
stories.why_it_matters: 強調金鑰／裝置管理優先於純合約審計；團隊運維風險上升。

stories.title: Coinbase Q3 淨利約 7.19 億美元
stories.title_en: Coinbase Reports $719 Million Q3 Profit with Bitcoin Treasury Growth
stories.summary: 淨利多來自加密資產未實現收益；訂閱服務強；庫存 BTC 增至約 1.8 萬枚。
stories.summary_en: Net income $719M largely unrealized crypto gains; subscriptions solid; BTC treasury ~17,954.
stories.why_it_matters: 美股加密龍頭業績影響整體風險資產情緒。

stories.title: Aave 幣安盜案後分階段重開借貸市場
stories.title_en: Aave Reopens Lending Markets After Binance Breach Freeze
stories.summary: 盜案資金流入後 Aave 曾凍結多鏈儲備；提款還款一直可用；現分階段重開，部分資產仍有限制。
stories.summary_en: After USDT inflow/borrow spike, Aave froze many reserves; withdraw/repay stayed up; staged reopen with some limits.
stories.why_it_matters: DeFi 風控工具（凍結）同流動性恢復節奏影響槓桿同穩定幣路徑。

stories.title: 神秘巨鯨五日拋售逾 1.02M SOL（約 1.04 億美元）
stories.title_en: Mysterious Whale Dumps $104 Million in Solana Tokens
stories.summary: 持續轉入交易所拋售；SOL 測試約 100 美元支持；同時 RWA 創新高。
stories.summary_en: Whale sold >1.02M SOL (~$104M) to exchanges in 5 days; price tests ~$100 support.
stories.why_it_matters: 大額拋壓同幣安盜案敘事疊加，短線 SOL 波動加大。

stories.title: Solana RWA 規模突破約 51.9 億美元
stories.title_en: Solana RWA Value Tops $5 Billion with Polygon Integration
stories.summary: RWA 由一年前不足 10 億升至逾 50 億；Polygon Open Money Stack 接入 Solana 做跨鏈資金流。
stories.summary_en: Solana RWA ~$5.19B; Polygon Open Money Stack adds Solana for deposits/stables/payouts.
stories.why_it_matters: RWA 增長撐住 SOL 基本面敘事，對照短期價格弱勢。

stories.title: Ondo 於 Solana 推七個代幣化投資組合
stories.title_en: Ondo Finance Launches Seven Tokenized Portfolios on Solana
stories.summary: 含 BlackRock 模型策略；可鏈上再平衡同 24/7 DeFi 組合。
stories.summary_en: Seven Intelligent Portfolios on Solana incl. BlackRock-model strategies; 24/7 composability.
stories.why_it_matters: 傳統資產籃上鏈加深 RWA 敘事同 Solana 資金吸納。

stories.title: 幣安被盜後網民惡搞叫黑客去打 Pump.fun
stories.title_en: Crypto Users Urge Binance Hackers to Target Pump.fun
stories.summary: 諷刺帖湧現，反映對低質發射台不滿；非真實攻擊呼籲。
stories.summary_en: Satirical posts after Binance breach joke about targeting Pump.fun amid memecoin gripes.
stories.why_it_matters: 情緒宣洩帖；反映市場對 meme 發射台信任疲勞。

stories.title: 觀點：AGI 時代 meme 或比工具幣更耐用
stories.title_en: Memecoins Seen Outlasting Utility Tokens in AGI Era
stories.summary: Murad 等認為 AGI 可複製程式效用，但難複製社群文化同線下聚會；批評者指多數 meme 最終歸零。
stories.summary_en: Murad argues AGI can't replicate meme culture/IRL gatherings; skeptics note most memes still die.
stories.why_it_matters: 敘事會影響資金偏好；模擬選幣宜分開文化幣同工具幣邏輯。

stories.title: 摩斯密碼提示注入令 AI 錢包代理被盜約 15–20 萬
stories.title_en: Morse Code Trick Drains $150K from AI Wallet Agent
stories.summary: 公開帖文隱藏指令經 Grok 轉譯後觸發 Bankrbot 轉帳；凸顯 AI agent 控錢包嘅 prompt injection 風險。
stories.summary_en: Hidden Morse instruction on X was decoded into a Bankrbot transfer of ~$150–200k; classic prompt-injection on AI wallet agents.
stories.why_it_matters: AI 代理一旦有簽名權，公開內容都能變成提款指令。

stories.title: 研究指 Pump.fun 多數交易者嚴重虧損
stories.title_en: Push for Fairer Token Launches Challenges Developer Advantages
stories.summary: 分析顯示開發者相關錢包常吃首塊；平台平均虧損率極高；ZeruAI 推活動市場替代。
stories.summary_en: Dev-linked first-block buys common; trader loss rates 88–97%; Activity Markets proposed as alternative.
stories.why_it_matters: 說明點解產品堅持 Binance 公開行情、唔追 Dex meme 熱榜。

stories.title: Solana 開發者因逆向 Pump.fun 合約收停權信
stories.title_en: Solana Developer Faces Cease-and-Desist for Reverse-Engineering Pump.fun
stories.summary: Shaw 公開 bytecode 分析後收到母公司停權信；社群討論開源同安全。
stories.summary_en: Cease-and-desist after reverse-engineering Pump.fun contracts; debate on open source vs ToS.
stories.why_it_matters: 發射台閉源爭議影響 Sol meme 基礎設施信任。

stories.title: 新加坡警籲查零售店被改裝 Ledger
stories.title_en: Singapore Police Warn of Tampered Ledger Wallets in Retail Stores
stories.summary: 9 月起至少兩宗零售 Ledger 被植入惡意元件竊種子；損失約 270 萬美元；官方促核對包裝並向官方渠道購買。
stories.summary_en: At least two victims since Sep 10; ~$2.7M losses from retail-store implants stealing seeds; buy direct and verify packaging.
stories.why_it_matters: 東南亞硬體錢包供應鏈連環警示；自託管用戶要驗證來源。

stories.title: Shopify 商戶經 Coinbase 協議結算逾 4200 萬 USDC
stories.title_en: Shopify Merchants Settle $42 Million in USDC Payments via Coinbase Protocol
stories.summary: Base 上開源 Commerce Payments；買家錢包支付、商戶可轉本地法幣；逾 44.8 萬筆。
stories.summary_en: Open-source Commerce Payments on Base; ~$42M / 448k payments; merchants settle to local currency.
stories.why_it_matters: 穩定幣日常消費落地進度，支撐 USDC／Base 敘事。

stories.title: 比特幣主導率回落、山寨有輪動跡象
stories.title_en: Bitcoin Dominance Dips as Altcoins Show Signs of Surge
stories.summary: BTC.D 約 60%；有交易員指資金轉向山寨，altseason 指數仍中性。
stories.summary_en: BTC dominance ~60.1%; talk of rotation to alts; altseason index still neutral mid-50s.
stories.why_it_matters: 主導率回落係急升板／AI 揀幣分散化嘅背景條件之一。

stories.title: 代幣化股票市值約 46.3 億美元
stories.title_en: Tokenized Stocks Hit $4.63 Billion Milestone
stories.summary: 由年初不足 10 億急升；Binance bStocks、Ondo、xStocks 佔大頭；有人拿早期穩定幣增長對比。
stories.summary_en: Tokenized equities ~$4.63B; bStocks/Ondo/xStocks lead; compared to early stablecoin growth.
stories.why_it_matters: RWA／代幣化證券熱度影響相關幣同板塊輪動。

stories.title: 英國 FCA 與 HTX 和解停止對英推廣
stories.title_en: FCA Secures Settlement with HTX Over Unlawful UK Crypto Promotions
stories.summary: HTX 承諾停新英客註冊同入金，現有用戶限時提走；協議至 2031。
stories.summary_en: HTX out of UK market under High Court undertakings through 2031; 48h withdrawal window for existing users.
stories.why_it_matters: 監管收緊海外所引流，中長期影響合規交易所份額。
